shortDescription: Create, update or delete racks within Nautobot

options.name: api_version
options.description: API Version Nautobot REST API

options.name: asset_tag
options.description: Asset tag that is associated to the rack.

options.name: comments
options.description: Comments that may include additional information in regards to the rack.

options.name: custom_fields
options.description: Must exist in Nautobot and in key/value format

options.name: desc_units
options.description: Rack units will be numbered top-to-bottom.

options.name: facility_id
options.description: The unique rack ID assigned by the facility.

options.name: id
options.description: The UUID of the object to operate on

options.name: location
options.description: The location the rack is located in Required if I(state=present) and the rack does not exist yet

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the rack. Required if I(state=present) and the rack does not exist yet

options.name: outer_depth
options.description: The outer depth of the rack.

options.name: outer_unit
options.description: Whether the rack unit is in Millimeters or Inches and is I(required) if outer_width/outer_depth is specified.

options.name: outer_width
options.description: The outer width of the rack.

options.name: query_params
options.description: This can be used to override the specified values in ALLOWED_QUERY_PARAMS that is defined in plugins/module_utils/utils.py and provides control to users on what may make an object unique in their environment.

options.name: rack_group
options.description: The rack group the rack will be associated to.

options.name: role
options.description: The rack role the rack will be associated to.

options.name: serial
options.description: Serial number of the rack.

options.name: state
options.description: Use C(present) or C(absent) for adding or removing.

options.name: status
options.description: The status of the rack Required if I(state=present) and does not exist yet.

options.name: tags
options.description: Any tags that this item may need to be associated with

options.name: tenant
options.description: The tenant that the device will be assigned to.

options.name: token
options.description: The token created within Nautobot to authorize API access Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_TOKEN) environment variable is configured.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of rack.

options.name: u_height
options.description: The height of the rack in rack units.

options.name: url
options.description: The URL of the Nautobot instance resolvable by the Ansible host (for example: http://nautobot.example.com:8000) Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_URL) environment variable is configured.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_VALIDATE_CERTS) environment variable is configured.

options.name: width
options.description: The rail-to-rail width.
